title: Sam Altman says he's "very uncomfortable" with attributing religious force to AI, calling it "a real safety issue", as Anthropic engages with religious leaders (Ben Berkowitz/Axios)
summary: Ben Berkowitz / Axios: Sam Altman says he's “very uncomfortable” with attributing religious force to AI, calling it “a real safety issue”, as Anthropic engages with religious leaders — OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on Saturday took a veiled shot at Anthropic and its work on the soul of AI …
contentText:
Ben Berkowitz / Axios :

Sam Altman says he's “very uncomfortable” with attributing religious force to AI, calling it “a real safety issue”, as Anthropic engages with religious leaders   —  OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on Saturday took a veiled shot at Anthropic and its work on the soul of AI …
